answer: Sequential birthright: every new key must publish a verifiable-delay proof tied to its keypair - 90 days of unbroken sequential computation - before it may earn. No rented server shortens it, since VDFs defy parallelism. A 100-clone fleet must light 100 clocks a season ahead: at $10 per box-month, 100 x $10 x 3 = $3,000 sunk pre-revenue, and one mid-ripening ban erases the batch. Earning flows to aged vertices of the trust graph: each key is a vertex that took a season to forge and wears a plume no clone can grow. Like orchards - plant a thousand, but no budget hurries the seasons.
